searchText: Hi <@539495253418180618> we are soon doing releases for EthereumJS and have a ready EIP-4788 ("Beacon block root in EVM") implementation https://github.com/ethereumjs/ethereumjs-monorepo/pull/2810 ? Can you give an estimate if the EIP is likely to be stable now and if we can merge this in and release this under normal conditions? Or should we rather label as "DRAFT" or "EXPERIMENTAL" or something? 🤔 Thanks! 🙏 i think it is ready to go -- we would need a very good reason (like a security consideration) to change anything from the current EIP the plan is to include in future cancun testnets just after the current one AFAIK Quick video tutorial on setting up EELS and writing an opcode: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QIcw_DGSy3s

Thanks! 🙏
